declaration: Configuration fixed before processing timings were observed; selected from capture-only and control-lock checks.
rationale: DSHOW+MJPG, exposure -6, 640x480 capture-only mean interval 33.8021385 ms; exposure, gain and white-balance locks passed. Previous -5/YUY2 official measurements are retained, not replaced or hidden.

camera.set_order: width, height, FPS, FOURCC LAST, then controls and exposure
camera.verification: All set returns true AND DSHOW/640x480/MJPG readbacks and fps within 0.01 of 30; exact webcam control readbacks. AUTO_EXPOSURE getter=-1 is unsupported, manual response established by frozen prior image tests; AUTOFOCUS getter=2 is the previously verified manual flag. Verify after requests, settling, selftest, immediately before timing and after timing. On failure no session starts or completed session is invalid.

protocol: Same live-search kernel, feature operations, models, selection and full-resolution LUT. Fresh Python process and camera reopen per session. First 50 of 2000 excluded; no data-dependent exclusion, trimming, retries or session replacement. Stop after a blocked or failed session. Preserve completed and partial outputs. Display disabled; no images retained.
selftest: Same live-search session_selftest: 100 newly captured frames, 9 candidates plus default 2/3, bit-identical rgb8, three features, NR-free/NR-mono scores and all four selector choices. Not timed. Failure stops work before measurement.

timing.processing_ms: Original live-search boundary: after common.frame returns to after unchanged kernel.process_frame returns. Includes RGB conversion, 256x256 bilinear resize, nine LUT candidates, features, NR-free score, selection and full-resolution LUT. Excludes capture, display, metadata writes.
timing.capture_decode_ms: perf_counter_ns strictly around underlying cap.read(), including waiting, transport and MJPG decoding together; these components cannot be separately identified.
timing.capture_wait_ms: Original common.frame wrapper, including the nested cap.read timers and shape check, for comparison with original live-search.
timing.camera_interval_ms: Differences between consecutive host common.frame completion timestamps, same as live-search; not sensor timestamps.
timing.capture_to_output_ms: From common.frame call start through completed correction in this iteration.
timing.end_to_end_loop_ms: Differences between consecutive corrected-output completion timestamps; includes inter-iteration bookkeeping and external-state check. Warmup predecessor supplies first retained interval.
timing.clock: perf_counter_ns; two extra timestamps solely inside capture, not inside processing; CSV and hashes after measurement

statistics.quantiles: numpy percentile linear; pool all retained frames, not session medians
statistics.deadline_miss: processing_ms > camera_interval_ms for the same row, historical live-search definition; also report processing >1000/30 ms nominal budget separately. This is a host-timestamp statistic, not proof about sensor arrival or dropped frames.
statistics.actual_loop_fps: retained count / sum of retained end_to_end_loop_ms *1000, identical to old endpoint formula; pooled sums of all three sessions
statistics.other: Capture/decode and end-to-end distributions reported. All frames retained after fixed warmup, including spikes.

preconditions.CPU: Single fixed five-second overall load sample <=10% before camera and again after selftest before each timed session; record power scheme and top ten non-idle processes. If >10%, stop pending; no automatic favorable-load retries.
preconditions.other_experiments: No concurrent model inference or inaccessible Python process during measurement. Check before and after each session.

comparison: Old -5 official cohort: main_1/main_2/main_3, 1950 retained each. Recompute extra metrics from immutable CSV. Old cap.read duration cannot be separated from common.frame validation; mark it capture wrapper. Old YUY2 label is supported by later reproduction of the old setting order, not an original per-session FOURCC record. Exposure and format both differ in new official comparison; do not attribute entire effect solely to format.
outputs: Per-frame timestamps, camera readbacks, selftests, environment checks, summaries and independent timestamp verification.
